title: Total derived unit/base-change coherence
statement: Let X and Y be schemes [def-pc-scheme], f : Y → X a morphism, and K an arbitrary bounded below derived abelian étale sheaf on X [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]. Write Γ and Γ′ for global sections [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology], L=f⁻¹ and R=f_* [def-weil-pbc-derived-inverse-image], and e:Γ⋙Id→L⋙Γ′ for the section map induced by the adjunction unit and R⋙Γ≅Γ′. Then R⁺Γ of the derived adjunction unit followed by the Leray comparison equals the inverse of the canonical derived identity comparison followed by rightDerivedFunctorPlusBaseChange(e), at K.

source.place: Cohomology, Lemma 01F8 (lemma-functoriality), equations 01F9 (equation-functorial-derived) and 01FA (equation-functorial), Remark 01FB (remark-explain-arrow); sites-cohomology.tex Remark 08J6 for the site version.

proof.text: Use the derived-unit formula to express the left-hand map as the right-derived descendant of the underived section map.

Compare descendants by rightDerived_ext. Naturality moves the identity comparison past the unit; base-change unit compatibility and identity factorization cancellation give the same section map on the homotopy category.

proof_origin.place: Canonical unit and homology comparisons in equations 01F9 and 01FA.
